prompts.2:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster enemy sprite concept sheet for a Chinese wuxing survival game.
Reference image is the CURRENT game's pixel-art screenshot, for STYLE AND SCALE ONLY. Respect its small chunky silhouettes, bright flat material colors, dark plum outer outline, 2-3 shade clusters per material, shallow three-quarter top-down view, enemies facing RIGHT. Create more recognizable creature anatomy while staying compatible with this humble 24-32px sprite language. NOT high-detail painterly art, not 3D, not detailed modern concept rendering, not realistic. No texture noise. Design at roughly 48-64px worth of information, later reduction will test 24-32px.
One 1536x1024 landscape sheet, EXACTLY SIX isolated subjects, strict THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Wide transparent gutters. Every entire subject inside central 70% of its own equal grid cell; no overlaps. No scenery, ground, particles, shadows, glow, foot rings, cell borders, labels or text. True transparent alpha. Camera and light upper-left are consistent across all.
A recognizable monster is more important than ornament. Strong silhouette holes between limbs. A few large highlights, no tiny hairs or scales. Monsters are compact and slightly cute but threatening. All bodies opaque, including ghosts; transparent only outside silhouettes.
LEVEL 2: BAMBOO GROVE. Layout:
TOP LEFT: BAMBOO GREEN PIT VIPER, immediately and unmistakably a SNAKE. Emerald-green long continuous limbless body laid in one broad low oval coil, with a thick neck rising in a clear S curve off the coil. OVERSIZED FLAT TRIANGULAR snake head projects horizontally RIGHT, distinctly wider than neck, pointed snout, one large gold slit eye, cream lower jaw and ONE long cream flank stripe, short red fork tongue and red tail TIP. Large negative space enclosed between raised neck and coil. Smooth continuous green skin; NO horns, NO ears, NO legs, NO leaves, NO bamboo sections, NO cobra hood, NO segmented worm rings. Body narrower than head. This is the priority design.
TOP CENTER: MIASMA TOAD at rest. Immediately unmistakably a TOAD, viewed 3/4 from side, head to RIGHT. Broad flattened WEDGE head, two bulging GOLD eyes mounted on TOP corners of skull, a very wide horizontal dark mouth slit spanning nearly entire head, pale throat below. Low squat ochre-brown body, large folded rear thigh on left, short front forelimbs propping head on right, splayed THREE chunky toes on visible forefoot. Clear dark gap beneath belly between forefoot and rear haunch. Exactly four amphibian legs, no tail. Only three small moss-green warts on back, not big bulbs. No snail shell, no tusks, no horns, no mammal muzzle. Head takes 40% of body length.
TOP RIGHT: established ROOT VINE DEMON, keep current game's identity: slim knotted green trunk, large ivory split wooden mask on top, two thick hooked vine arms, three thick root feet, just TWO big leaves. Root limbs visibly separate from trunk. Not a leafy sphere.
BOTTOM LEFT: established MOSS TERRACOTTA SENTINEL, same squat square broad-shouldered terracotta warrior as current game's first-level small soldiers, ochre clay large face, topknot, blocky fists, short separated feet. Small moss patches only on shoulder tops and scalp, clay remains dominant.
BOTTOM CENTER: THOUSAND-YEAR TREE BOSS. Broad irregular hollow trunk with huge dark split face and glowing two eyes, two long branch arms clearly separated, three thick root legs, asymmetric flat masses of sage canopy in top half. Boss has one trunk body, no humanoid legs or clothes. Deep brown and light ochre wood, muted jade leaves. A few large branch cuts, no tiny foliage. Will be 64x64 in game.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SAME MIASMA TOAD as top center, same body and identity, but preparing to SPIT: broad pale throat sack swells beneath its mouth, front legs brace, chin lifts slightly. Do NOT make a round balloon whole-body, preserve folded rear thigh and bulging eyes. No projectile.

LEVEL 3 MOUNTAIN FOREST. Six cells:
TOP LEFT: ROCK TERRACOTTA SENTINEL, same square ochre terracotta soldier as current level 1, short legs, broad fists, large clay face and topknot. Only the two shoulders have pale angular rock caps and one broad crack. Earth-colored body remains dominant, NO all-gray stone golem.
TOP CENTER: ROCK-THROWING MOUNTAIN MANDRILL SPIRIT. Clearly an APE: hunched heavy shoulders, two long muscular arms, small hind legs, broad flat red muzzle and pale eyebrows, tawny-brown fur. One large pale stone held in a hand ABOVE and beside the head, separate silhouette, NOT a hat. Head must clearly read as primate, not goblin or fox; broad cheeks and brow, no pointed ears. Compact leaning forward pose.
TOP RIGHT: PANGOLIN, immediately recognizable animal profile to right. Long narrow tapered snout, small eye, NO visible ears; low arched body on FOUR short clawed legs, very LONG thick tapered tail sweeping left behind. THREE rows of LARGE overlapping triangular ochre armor plates. Smooth underside, claws visible, no reptile spikes, no hedgehog pins, no turtle shell, no round blob. Tail occupies one third of width.
BOTTOM LEFT: MIASMA TOAD matching image 2 TOP CENTER: ochre squat toad, bulging gold eyes on top, broad flat mouth, large folded haunch, short propping front legs, just three green warts and pale throat. This is the same creature from bamboo grove.
BOTTOM CENTER: ROOT VINE DEMON matching image 2 TOP RIGHT: ivory split wooden mask, knotted green trunk, two hooked vine arms and three separate root feet; same identity and proportion.
BOTTOM RIGHT: MOUNTAIN APE KING BOSS. Very wide powerful GORILLA/mandrill-like body with two immense forearms and knuckles on ground, small muscular rear legs, huge red primate face framed by thick ivory brow and cheek ruff. Slate rock-like shoulder fur in two broad masses, warm ochre chest, deep umber arms. A low pentagonal silhouette with animal musculature, NOT a rectangular building, no triangular tent body. This is 56x48 boss scale.

LEVEL 4 EMBER VALLEY. Six cells:
TOP LEFT: EMBER CROW, preserve first-level current crow identity: charcoal plum compact bird flying RIGHT, prominent pointed crow beak, one bright gold eye, two broad triangular orange-red wings raised, pale orange glowing chest crop expressed as solid pixels, short flame-shaped tail. TOP CENTER: RED FOX in a forward running crouch. Immediately recognizable FOX: two big pointed ears, narrow wedge muzzle with dark nose, slim reddish-orange body, FOUR black-tipped feet, ONE oversized bushy flame-shaped tail with cream tip trailing left. TOP RIGHT: FIRE SPRITE / CHARCOAL FURNACE IMP. Short pear-shaped floating broken clay furnace shell, charcoal-purple rounded sides, wide open fiery mouth/window with simple pale orange core, two small stubby handle-like arms. On top TWO flame tongues, solid orange shapes. A compact hollow vessel creature, not an ordinary floating projectile, not a lantern with thin wires. Body silhouette enclosed and chunky.
BOTTOM LEFT: LAVA-CRUST TERRACOTTA SENTINEL, same small broad square terracotta guardian as level 1, ochre face and torso, dark basalt crust on shoulder caps and forehead ONLY, two bright orange fissures. Clay still dominant (EARTH enemy), not a fully red fire golem. Large fists, squat legs.
BOTTOM CENTER: BIFANG BOSS, a Chinese mythical CRANE with exactly ONE long sturdy visible leg. Turquoise/teal body, long S-shaped neck, long straight ivory crane beak, two enormous upward angled wings with cinnabar red edging forming a tall V. Each wing is 3-4 big feather blocks, not thin lines. Preserve avian body and one-leg crane silhouette; NOT a phoenix, not a crow, not humanoid. The one leg needs enough thickness to survive a 56x48 reduction.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME charcoal FURNACE IMP as top right, attack preparation pose: body tilts backward and mouth opening widens to a bright upward-facing oval, ready to LOB a fireball. Keep identity and mass, no projectile or explosion.

LEVEL 5 ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD. Six cells:
TOP LEFT: REVENANT BROKEN SOLDIER. Thin, crooked, clearly asymmetric ancient Chinese haunted lamellar soldier, dented wide-brim iron helmet with one broken side, empty dark face with two small pale eyes, one shoulder armor missing, torn gray-white sash, broken short saber in one hand and a SHORT broad torn battle pennant mounted on the back. Cold gray metal with rusty brown accents; no exposed gore or zombie flesh. Legs separated, bent shambling posture. Not a cute robot.
TOP CENTER: IRON SPEAR SOLDIER, consistent with upgraded first-level design. Compact narrow forward-leaning body with broad Chinese iron hat/brim and hanging segmented neck guard, dark empty face, pale steel large shoulder plates, small red plume and sash, a thick broad spear pointing diagonally right. Squared feet firmly planted. Not a European T-visor knight, no medieval greathelm.
TOP RIGHT: FLYING SICKLE, an unmistakably floating CRESCENT blade demon. A large silver moon-sickle arc facing RIGHT with LARGE open central negative space, one small ancient bronze face ornament hanging on the inner upper arc, TWO short chunky chain links only below. Thick blade with three broad brightness bands, not a ring with a man inside, not a humanoid, not a circular shield. The asymmetry and central hollow distinguish it from projectiles.
BOTTOM LEFT: ARMOR TERRACOTTA SENTINEL, the same broad square first-level clay guardian, ochre large face and torso, blocky fists and short legs. One battered steel shoulder plate on left and one broken smaller plate on right, ONE short snapped arrow in chest. Ochre EARTH body remains dominant. No full metal body.
BOTTOM CENTER: BATTLEFIELD PANGOLIN, same low arched four-legged long-tailed pangolin animal as the mountain level, long tapered snout, no ears, large overlapping ochre plates. Just TWO rusty salvaged lamellar plates loosely lodged on back and one pale bone chip. Still visibly a pangolin, not a mammal in a full suit of armor; tail clearly extends left, earthy palette.
BOTTOM RIGHT: XINGTIAN BOSS, headless mythic warrior, absolutely NO head above torso. Wide powerful copper-brown inverted-trapezoid body with two stylized EYES on chest and one toothy MOUTH on belly; dark steel lamellar skirt and two sturdy feet. One enormous round bronze shield on left, one large chunky Chinese ceremonial axe on right, both separated from body by clear gaps. Non-graphic flat neck top, no blood or injury detail. 56x56 scale. Shield silhouette and axe silhouette must be unmistakable at small size.

LEVEL 6 CLOUD-DREAM MARSH. Six cells:
TOP LEFT: WATER GHOST from current first level, pale blue face clearly projecting RIGHT, long dark indigo hair in TWO thick swept-back locks, pale celadon wide sleeve and one reaching hand, curled S-shape dark blue watery robe tail. Forward fast ghost silhouette, no legs, not a blue fireball. Opaque flat colors, no transparent smoke.
TOP CENTER: FISH DEMON, immediately a FISH that waddles on two broad fins. Huge blunt fish head with a round protruding open mouth aimed diagonally UP and RIGHT (lobbed water projectile behavior), one very large golden fish eye, short deep teal scaled body, tall reddish-orange dorsal fin, broad recognizable forked tail to LEFT, two chunky pectoral fins touching ground. No arms, no clothing, no frog thighs; fish anatomy first. No bubbles or projectile.
TOP RIGHT: JIAO WATER DRAGON, elongated low horizontal body with a distinct long dragon head, two small back-swept horns, short broad jaw whiskers, exactly FOUR short clawed limbs, one long tail. Cobalt and slate-blue body with pale blue belly and three large dorsal ridges. Lunging forward to right, longer and lower than bamboo snake; head not triangular snake head. No wings, no long thin whiskers. This fits a 30x22 sprite.
BOTTOM LEFT: ROOT VINE DEMON identical to reference 2 TOP RIGHT. Ivory split wooden mask, knotted green trunk, two hooked arms, three root feet, two leaves. Do not redesign into seaweed or recolor blue, it remains WOOD.
BOTTOM CENTER: BAMBOO GREEN VIPER identical to reference 2 TOP LEFT. A single continuous GREEN snake body coiled low, neck clearly in S and triangular large head pointing right, cream lower jaw and flank stripe, red tail tip. NO limbs or horns. This remains WOOD and must be unmistakably different from the blue four-legged jiao.
BOTTOM RIGHT: XIANGLIU BOSS, a dark teal serpentine creature with exactly NINE pale celadon SNAKE HEADS on thick separate necks rising from ONE compact coiled dark blue body. Organize nine heads into THREE clearly separated fans of THREE heads each, stepped heights; central head highest, eight lateral heads spaced with background gaps between neck groups. Small gold eyes, broad pale jaws; open only 2 mouths to avoid noise. No dragon wings, no octopus suction cups, no hydra limbs. Avoid hair-thin necks and tangled noodle bundle. Use much bigger BOSS body within the cell than the regular monsters, but keep margins. This boss will be tested at 56x56 pixels; nine heads must remain countable.

REFINEMENT:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the BOTTOM RIGHT nine-headed serpent boss in the supplied six-creature sheet.
The current boss has EIGHT heads; it must have EXACTLY NINE. Add ONE extra short serpentine neck and head in the open lower-central gap, above the front coil and BELOW the current middle central head. New head points right, with teal scales, one golden eye and pale cream lower jaw, same pixel-block style and same head size as the existing lower heads. Make a clear dark/transparent separation from neighboring necks so all NINE heads can be counted.
Keep all existing eight heads and the single coiled body. Do not remove or merge any heads.
Preserve the other FIVE creatures pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. Preserve all grid positions, scale, transparent background, colors and style. No text, no effects or extra objects. Keep transparent alpha.
